mods.title: miikeskii’s QoL Pack

ai_authorship.quote: The code was written by Claude, Anthropic’s AI (the Claude Opus 5 and Opus 5.5 models, working as Claude Code agents), for miikeskii.

warnings: This is a 28-mod client-side collection. Remove duplicate standalone mods before using the bundled versions; the pack is designed not to require installation on the server or other players.
Requires Valheim with BepInExPack 5.4.2350 and Jötunn 2.30.2.

XPortal Map Picker reflects into XPortal 1.2.25, which the package credits as required, but XPortal is absent from the Thunderstore manifest dependency list; the picker may need XPortal installed separately.

The README documents interactions to consider: shared chest transfer waits until the game releases the chest; other loose-item mods may conflict; another mod scanning all dropped items may freeze on large deposits; crops beneath cage floors die for clients without Bar None.
The package includes GPL-3.0 and credits copied/adapted and runtime-integrated components. No license finding was identified in this review; retain the included license and credits if redistributing.
The exact release passed complete static security review, but Valheim installation, compatibility, runtime behavior, and gameplay were not tested.
